ortak.cevrimdisi: No internet connection — changes cannot be saved.
ortak.saltOkunur: You have view-only access to this screen.

tasarim.aciklama: Drag and drop fields to arrange the form. Changes stay in the draft; users are unaffected until you publish.
tasarim.paletAciklama: Drag onto the canvas to add. Drag a field back here to remove it.
tasarim.satirKolonlariAciklama: Reorder with the arrows, set the width in pixels, switch off columns you do not use.
tasarim.birimPxAciklama: The grid grows with its content and scrolls sideways.
tasarim.birimYuzdeAciklama: Width is a share of the screen; above 100% total the grid scrolls horizontally.
tasarim.ekranSecAciklama: Choose the screen whose design you want to change.
tasarim.onayRoluAciklama: Used as the ERP approval role when a request is submitted. Published together with the design.
tasarim.alanSecin: Select a field on the canvas to see its settings.
tasarim.gizliAciklama: The field is not shown to users, but the default value below is still submitted. To drop it entirely, drag it back to the palette.
tasarim.saltOkunurKilitli: This value is generated by the program; it is always read-only.
tasarim.kaldirilamaz: This field is required for saving and cannot be removed.
tasarim.yayinlandi: Design published; users now see this layout.
tasarim.yayinOnayMesaj: This layout will apply to all users. The previous version is archived and can be restored.
tasarim.kolonSec: Select a column to change its settings.
tasarim.erpZorunlu: ERP marks this field as required; it cannot be turned off.

dogrulama.enAzBirSatir: At least one request line is required.
dogrulama.aciklamaUzun: Description may be at most 200 characters.
dogrulama.hakkindaUzun: About may be at most 3072 characters.
dogrulama.adresUzun: Delivery address may be at most 200 characters.

anasayfa.aciklama: Access your ERP operations from the left menu.
anasayfa.bosDurum: The Purchase Request module will be here soon.

sql.aciklama: Test and Live connection definitions for the ERP MSSQL server. Stored procedures run against the active environment.
sql.sifreNotu: Leave blank to keep the saved password. Re-enter it if you change the server, port or username.
sql.aktifOrtamAciklama: Applies to all users: ERP writes (stored procedure calls) go to the selected environment's database.
sql.testSecimAciklama: Writes go to the test database — safe to experiment.
sql.canliSecimAciklama: Writes go to the production ERP database.
sql.canliOnayMesaj: From now on ALL writes will go to the production ERP database. Are you sure you want to continue?

dogrulama.portGecersiz: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
dogrulama.sifreZorunlu: Password is required on first save.

mail.aciklama: SMTP server and sender details for mails sent by the application (alerts, notifications).
mail.sifreNotu: Password is saved. Leave blank to keep it. Re-enter it if you change the server, port, username or encryption.
mail.sifreGirilmedi: No password yet; mail cannot be sent while a username is set.
mail.yonlendirmeAciklama: If set, ALL mails sent by the application go only to this address, not to the real recipients. Use during testing.
mail.yonlendirmeAktif: Redirect is on: all mails go only to {{adres}}.
mail.testAciklama: Sends a test mail with the saved settings; unsaved changes are not used. SMTP acceptance does not guarantee delivery to the inbox.
mail.testGonderildi: Test mail handed to the SMTP server: {{alici}}

dogrulama.sunucuGecersiz: Enter only the host name (e.g. smtp.office365.com), without scheme, port or spaces.
dogrulama.portGecersiz: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.

entegrator.aciklama: Test and Live account definitions of the e-Invoice integrator (İzibiz). Invoices are read from the active environment.
entegrator.sifreNotu: Leave blank to keep the saved password. Re-enter it if you change the username or the API address.
entegrator.sinamaKapsami: This test only verifies the username and password; permission to read invoices is checked separately when listing.
entegrator.ortamUyumsuz: Warning: ERP (SQL) and the integrator are in different environments. Reconciliation and alerts will use data from different environments; results may be misleading.
entegrator.aktifOrtamAciklama: Applies to all users: invoices are read from the integrator account of the selected environment. Chosen independently of the SQL environment.
entegrator.testSecimAciklama: Invoices are read from the integrator's test account.
entegrator.canliSecimAciklama: Invoices are read from the real integrator account.
entegrator.canliOnayMesaj: After this, invoices will be read from the real integrator account. Are you sure you want to continue?

dogrulama.sifreZorunlu: Password is required on first save.
dogrulama.vknGecersiz: Tax ID must be 10 digits (national ID 11) and contain only digits.
dogrulama.apiAdresiGecersiz: Address must be https://host (no path or query).
dogrulama.aralikGecersiz: Interval must be between 15 and 1440 minutes (İzibiz: at least 15).
dogrulama.sayfaGecersiz: Must be between 10 and 100 (İzibiz: at most 100).

entegrator.apiAdresiNotu: If left empty, the environment default is used: {{varsayilan}}. Re-enter the password if you change the address.
entegrator.senkronAyarlariNotu: İzibiz rules: automatic fetching at most every 15 minutes, at most 100 invoices per request. The active environment’s setting is used.

protel.aciklama: The hotel's incoming e-invoices are read only. The active environment is chosen independently of İzibiz.
protel.modulKapali: The Protel connection is disabled on the server (PROTEL_AKTIF). Definitions can be saved, but testing and sync send no requests to Protel.
protel.adresNotu: If left empty, the environment default is used: {{varsayilan}}. Only https and the protel.com.tr domain; re-enter the password if you change the address.
protel.senkronNotu: Automatic fetching runs at most every 15 minutes; each run reads invoices that reached Protel in the last 10 days. The active environment's setting is used.
protel.ortamSec: Protel invoices are read from this environment
protel.canliOnayBaslik: Switch Protel to the live environment?
protel.canliOnayMesaj: Protel invoices will be read from the live account. Nothing is changed in Protel.

dogrulama.aralikGecersiz: Interval must be between 15 and 1440 minutes.

roller.aciklamaMetni: Roles group permissions; roles are assigned to users on the Users screen. System administrators already have every permission.
roller.kopyaBilgisi: The description and permissions of "{{ad}}" were copied; saving adds them as a new role. User assignments are not copied. Enter a different name for the new role.
roller.silOnayMesaj: Role "{{ad}}" will be deleted; {{sayi}} user(s) will lose its permissions.

dogrulama.adCokUzun: Role name can be at most 64 characters.
dogrulama.aciklamaCokUzun: Description can be at most 255 characters.

kullanicilar.aciklama: ERP users are listed. Only users granted access here can sign in, with their ERP password; what they see comes from their roles. ERP system administrators can always sign in.
kullanicilar.erpBilgiNotu: Name and password come from the ERP; only access and roles change here.
kullanicilar.pasifYapilamazNotu: Your own account's and the backup admin's access cannot be removed.
kullanicilar.yoneticiNotu: As a system administrator (ERP flag) this user already has every permission.
kullanicilar.girisIzni: Can sign in to the app
kullanicilar.erpOkunamadi: Could not reach the ERP; only users defined in the app are listed. Defining new users requires the ERP connection.

alarm.aciklama: Mail alerts for e-Invoices. Rules are evaluated on the active integrator account; alerts of the test account go only to the redirect address on the Mail (SMTP) screen. Mails carry no invoice details, only counts and a link.

parametre.gun: Days to wait after arrival at İzibiz

senkron_arizasi.aciklama: Technical alert when fetching from İzibiz fails repeatedly or data is not updated for the given time; a "resolved" mail when it recovers.

gunluk_ozet.aciklama: Every day at the given time, counts and totals of incoming and outgoing invoices first seen the previous day.

erp_okumadi.aciklama: Once a day, newly found incoming invoices that the ERP has not read although they reached İzibiz more than the given days ago. No alert when data is stale.

dogrulama.aliciZorunlu: An active rule needs at least one recipient.
dogrulama.aliciGecersiz: One of the recipients is not a valid e-mail address.
dogrulama.aralik: Enter a whole number between {{en}} and {{cok}}.

bildirim.aciklamaMetni: Failed or deliberately skipped notifications are listed too, so the reason for a missing mail is visible here.

kodlar.OLAY_KAPANDI: The problem was resolved before sending.
kodlar.TEST_YONLENDIRME_YOK: Test account alert; not sent to real recipients because no redirect address is set on the Mail (SMTP) screen.
kodlar.YENI_OLAY_YOK: Evaluated; no new invoices to report.
kodlar.SMTP_HATASI: The SMTP server did not accept the mail; will retry.
kodlar.ACILIS_GONDERILMEDI: Not sent because the opening mail of this problem was never sent.

hata.AG_HATASI: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
hata.YETKISIZ: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
hata.ERISIM_ENGELLI: You are not authorized for this action.
hata.DOGRULAMA: There are errors in the submitted data.
hata.COK_FAZLA_ISTEK: Too many requests; please wait a moment.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_ERISILEMEDI: Could not reach the integrator. Check the network and try again.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_KIMLIK_HATALI: Integrator username or password is incorrect.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_GIRIS_BEKLETILIYOR: The integrator rejected the login, so automatic logins are paused for 6 hours (to avoid locking the account). Update the password in Settings → Integrator Connections or retry with "Test Connection".
hata.ENTEGRATOR_YANIT_GECERSIZ: The integrator returned an unexpected response.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_AKTIF_YOK: No active integrator environment is selected.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_ORTAM_DEGISTI: The active integrator environment changed; the list on screen belongs to the previous environment. Export again after the list refreshes.
hata.PROTEL_KAPALI: The Protel connection is disabled on the server (PROTEL_AKTIF); no request was sent to Protel.
hata.guncellendiOtomatik: A new version has been installed; it takes effect after a refresh.
hata.guncellendiElle: Refresh the page to switch to the new version.
hata.EFATURA_EXCEL_COK_BUYUK: The filter matches more invoices than the Excel limit. Narrow the date range.
hata.EFATURA_SENKRON_SURUYOR: A manual sync is already queued or running.
hata.EFATURA_SENKRON_KAPALI: e-Invoice sync is disabled on the server.
hata.BEKLENMEYEN_HATA: An unexpected error occurred during sync (see server log).
hata.YAZMA_HATASI: Invoices could not be written to the database.
hata.ERP_OKUNAMADI: Could not read the ERP; eMOR was not changed. Please try again shortly.
hata.ERP_CANLI_TANIMSIZ: No live ERP connection is defined. Define the Live environment under Settings → SQL Connections.
hata.ERP_OKUMA_YETKISI_YOK: The ERP database user is not allowed to read this data. Ask the database administrator for SELECT permission.
hata.ERP_OKUMA_HATASI: ERP could not be read. Please try again shortly.
hata.KAYIT_KULLANILIYOR: This record is used by other records and cannot be deleted.
hata.ICE_AKTARIM_HATALI: There are invalid rows; nothing was saved. Fix the errors below and check again.
hata.KESINTI_EXCEL_COK_BUYUK: The selected filter has more rows than the Excel limit. Narrow the filter.
hata.YEDEKLEME_KAPALI: The backup module is disabled on the server (YEDEKLEME_AKTIF).
hata.ISTEK_BULUNAMADI: The job request was not found (it may have expired or been cleaned up).
hata.ISTEK_PARAMETRE_GECERSIZ: The job request parameters are invalid.
hata.ISTEK_SURESI_DOLDU: The job request was too old and was not processed; please try again.
hata.ISTEK_DOSYASI_GECERSIZ: The job request could not be read.
hata.YEDEK_DOGRULANAMAZ: This backup cannot be verified: only signed, completed backups can be verified.
hata.YEDEK_SABIT: A pinned backup cannot be deleted; unpin it first.
hata.YEDEK_KULLANIMDA: The backup is in use (being copied or restored); try again shortly.
hata.YEDEK_SILINMIS: The backup has already been deleted.
hata.YEDEK_BEKLENMEYEN_HATA: An unexpected backup error occurred (see the server log).
hata.YEDEK_KOPYA_SILINEMEDI: Some copies of the backup could not be deleted.
hata.YEDEK_TARAMA_BASARISIZ: The backup folder could not be scanned.
hata.YEDEK_KILIT_MESGUL: Another backup operation is running; try again when it finishes.
hata.YEDEK_ACIK_GERI_YUKLEME: No backup was taken because a restore is in progress.
hata.YEDEK_DOSYA_HATASI: The backup file could not be written or read.
hata.YEDEK_YAPILANDIRMA_HATASI: Backups are not configured correctly on the server.
hata.YEDEK_YARIDA_KALDI: The process taking the backup stopped before finishing; the backup is incomplete.
hata.YEDEK_ANAHTAR_GECERSIZ: The key could not be read: paste a valid ASCII-armored OpenPGP public key.
hata.YEDEK_ANAHTAR_OZEL: This is a PRIVATE key. Only a public key may be uploaded to the server; keep the private key in its own safe place.
hata.YEDEK_ANAHTAR_SURESI_DOLMUS: The key has expired; upload a valid public key.
hata.YEDEK_OZEL_ANAHTAR_OKUNAMADI: The private key could not be read.
hata.YEDEK_ANAHTAR_PAROLASI_HATALI: The private key passphrase is wrong.
hata.YEDEK_SIFRE_COZULEMEDI: The encrypted copy could not be decrypted (wrong key or corrupt file).
hata.YEDEK_GPG_HATASI: The encryption tool (gpg) could not be run.
hata.HEDEF_KULLANILIYOR: The target is in use: used by {{plan}} plan(s), {{kopya}} copies. Remove it from the plans first; a target with copies cannot be deleted but can be deactivated.
hata.HEDEF_TURU_UYGUN_DEGIL: This action is not available for this target type.
hata.HEDEF_ERISILEMEDI: The target could not be reached (address, port or network).
hata.HEDEF_KONUMU_DEGISMEZ: This target holds copies; the fields that define where they are stored (server, folder, bucket, connected account…) cannot be changed. Add a new target for another location; passwords / keys can be renewed.
hata.HEDEF_SINAMA_SURESI_DOLDU: The test ran out of time; this step was not run.
hata.YEDEK_IMZA_ANAHTARI_YOK: The backup signing key is missing or unreadable; settings were not saved. Check the server setup.
hata.YEDEK_AYAR_KOPYASI_YAZILAMADI: The settings file copy could not be written; the change was rolled back and settings are unchanged.
hata.HEDEF_KIMLIK_HATALI: The target's user name, password or key is wrong.
hata.HEDEF_YAZILAMADI: Could not write to the target (permission or folder).
hata.HEDEF_OKUNAMADI: Could not read from the target.
hata.HEDEF_SILINEMEDI: The file on the target could not be deleted.
hata.HEDEF_SILME_YETKISI_YOK: The target does not allow deletion (immutable retention); the target's own rule removes old copies.
hata.HEDEF_KOTA_DOLU: The target's storage quota is full.
hata.HEDEF_YENIDEN_BAGLAN: The target account was disconnected; reconnect it.
hata.HEDEF_SUNUCU_PARMAK_IZI_DEGISTI: The server key (fingerprint) has changed; the connection was refused for safety. If the change is expected, reset the server key.
hata.HEDEF_SERTIFIKA_HATASI: The server certificate could not be verified.
hata.HEDEF_BAGLI_DEGIL: The network share is not mounted on the server.
hata.HEDEF_ANA_DOSYA: The file on the target is the backup itself (same location); it does not count as a separate copy. Use a different folder for the target.
hata.HEDEF_YAPILANDIRMA_HATASI: The target definition is incomplete or the server is not configured for this target.
hata.GOOGLE_DURUM_GECERSIZ: The Google connection request is invalid or expired. Click "Connect with Google" again.
hata.PLAN_KOPYALI: This plan has {{kopya}} copies and cannot be deleted. You can deactivate it instead (its history is kept).
hata.PLAN_HEDEFI_KOPYALI: A target that has copies cannot be removed from the plan.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_HEDEF_ADI_GECERSIZ: The restore target name is invalid.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_HEDEF_VAR: A database with this name already exists.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_OZET_TUTMUYOR: The backup file checksum does not match the manifest.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_YEDEK_DOSYASI_YOK: The backup file is not on disk.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_OZEL_ANAHTAR_GEREKLI: This backup exists only as an encrypted off-server copy; it needs the private key and cannot be restored from the screen. Use the command-line procedure (docs/yedekleme/kurtarma.md).
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_VERITABANI_OZELLIGI: Database properties could not be read.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_VERITABANI_OLUSTURULAMADI: The database could not be created.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_KARSILASTIRMA_TUTMADI: The restored data does not match the manifest.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_VERITABANI_SILINEMEDI: The temporary database could not be dropped.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_ACIK_GERI_YUKLEME: A restore is already in progress.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_ISLEM_DURUMU_OKUNAMADI: The operation state could not be read.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_KOPYA_YOK: The restored copy was not found.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_YAPILANDIRMA_HATASI: Restore is not configured on the server.
hata.ISTEK_BEKLENMEYEN_HATA: An unexpected error occurred while running the job (see the server log).
hata.ISTEK_ISLEYICISI_YOK: This job type cannot be run on the server.
hata.ISTEK_KULLANICI_YOK: The user who requested the job was not found.
hata.ISTEK_YARIDA_KALDI: The job was interrupted (the runner stopped); please try again.
hata.ISTEK_YETKI_YOK: You are not allowed to do this (permission re-checked while processing).
hata.ISTEK_GONDEREN_DOGRULANAMADI: The sender of the job request could not be verified; the request was not processed.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_YAYIN_SURUYOR: A deployment is in progress; the overwrite restore was not started. Try again when it finishes.
hata.YEDEK_ISLEM_DURUMU_OKUNAMADI: The backup operation state could not be read; nothing was done, for safety.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_SERVIS_GEREKLI: Overwrite restore is not possible until the service-account runner is installed (YEDEKLEME_CALISTIRICI=servis).
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_ONAY_METNI_TUTMUYOR: The typed name does not match the live database name.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_SEMA_BILINMIYOR: This is an imported legacy backup: it has no migration list, so schema compatibility cannot be checked and it cannot be restored over the live database (it can be restored as a copy).
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_SEMA_UYUMSUZ: The backup contains migrations this code does not have (code rolled back or backup from another branch); refused before starting.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_DISK_YETERSIZ: Not enough free disk space; the operation did not start.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_BAKIM_MODU_HATASI: The application could not be put into or taken out of maintenance mode.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_KUYRUK_SERVISI_HATASI: The queue service could not be stopped or started.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_ONCESI_YEDEK_BASARISIZ: The pre-restore backup failed; the operation stopped and the live database was not touched.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_MIGRATION_HATASI: Migrations failed on the restored database; the live database was not touched.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_BAGLANTI_KAPATILAMADI: Connections to the live database could not be closed.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_YER_DEGISTIRILEMEDI: The databases could not be swapped; names are unchanged.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_ADLAR_TUTARSIZ: Database names are not in the expected state; inspect with the emergency command.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_DIZIN_KURULAMADI: The backup index could not be rebuilt after the swap.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_AYAR_UZLASTIRILAMADI: Settings could not be reconciled after the swap.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_YONETICI_GERI_DONDU: The administrator chose to go back; the application opened with the old database.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_BEKLENMEYEN_HATA: An unexpected restore error occurred (see the server log).
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_ERISIM_ANAHTARI_GECERSIZ: The access key is invalid or does not belong to this operation.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_ERISIM_ANAHTARI_SURESI_DOLD: The access key has expired. Approval and rollback can be done on the server with the emergency command below.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_ISLEM_DURUMU_UYGUN_DEGIL: The operation cannot be approved or rolled back at this step.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_BILINMEYEN_ADIM: The operation state shows an unknown step; inspect with the emergency command.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_SERVIS_ROLU_GEREKLI: Restoring over the live database requires a service role separate from the application role (YEDEKLEME_ROL) and its password file.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_YAZICI_BARIYERI: Sessions writing to the live database could not be stopped; the operation was rolled back, the live database was not touched.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_VERITABANI_YETKILERI: The database connection privileges could not be applied equivalently (e.g. a role in them does not exist on this server); privileges unchanged.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_AYAR_SECIMI_EKSIK: Choose "current" or "restored" for every settings group that differs.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_AYAR_SECIMI_UYGULANAMADI: The current settings could not be written; no setting changed and the application is still in maintenance mode. Change the choice and approve again, or go back.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_KARAR_SURESI_DOLDU: The decision expired (5 minutes) and was not applied. Decide again.
hata.GERI_YUKLEME_KARAR_KANITI_KULLANILDI: This decision was already processed; it was not applied again.

izin.efatura_gizle: Hide / restore e-invoices in the list
izin.protel_faturalari_disari_aktar: Export the Protel list to Excel
izin.geri_yukleme_kopya: Restore a backup under a new name (copy)

efatura.excelAciklama: Exports the table as shown: the records on this page and the visible columns. For more records choose "All" as page size (at most 1000 records per page).
efatura.erpOkunduNotu: Integrator flag used by the ERP integration. This screen only shows it and never changes it.
efatura.veriZamaniYok: No successful sync covering today yet.
efatura.senkronKapali: Scheduled sync is disabled on the server; the list is not updated automatically.
efatura.guncelDegil: Data may be stale: no successful sync covering today in the last hour. Recent invoices may be missing.
efatura.tumGuncelDegil: {{saglayici}} invoices may be stale (last successful update: {{zaman}}). The reason is shown in the sync panel of the {{saglayici}} screen.
efatura.ardisikHata: Last {{sayi}} sync runs failed or were incomplete ({{neden}}, {{zaman}}).

dogrulama.sira: End date cannot be before start date.
dogrulama.cokGenis: The date range can be at most {{gun}} days.

senkron.aciklama: Incoming and outgoing invoices in the selected range are re-read from İzibiz (at most {{gun}} days). The job runs in the background; this screen shows its status.
senkron.sirada: Manual sync is queued or running ({{baslangic}} – {{bitis}}).

dogrulama.gelecek: End date cannot be in the future.
dogrulama.sira: End date cannot be before start date.
dogrulama.cokGenis: The range can be at most {{gun}} days.

efatura.durumAlinamadi: Sync status could not be loaded; it is unknown whether the list is current.

kolon.sistemBekleniyor: This will be filled once the SAP service is available.

erpSenkron.aciklama: Checks now whether the invoices in this list exist in the ERP (incoming: TOHOM_FATURA and TOHOM_HARCAMA_BELGESI, outgoing: sent e-invoice list) and updates the eMOR column. Also runs automatically every 5 minutes.
erpSenkron.tamam: eMOR updated: {{islendi}} processed, {{elle_islendi}} entered manually, {{havuzda}} in pool, {{yok}} not in ERP ({{degisen}} changed).

aciklama.islendi: Accepted into accounting (TOHOM_FATURA / TOHOM_HARCAMA_BELGESI, by ETTN)
aciklama.elle_islendi: Entered into the ERP manually without e-invoice matching: no ETTN, found by invoice number and tax id
aciklama.havuzda: Received by the ERP (TOHOM_E_FATURA), not yet accounted

efatura.istisnaFarkli: Exemption code differs between the integrator and the ERP

gizleme.aciklama: Hide the invoice if it is not ours (e.g. issued to another of our companies with the same tax id and delivered to the wrong mailbox). It is not deleted; it stays at the integrator and can be restored.
gizleme.gizliAciklama: This invoice is hidden from the list. Restoring shows it again.
gizleme.gizlendi: Invoice hidden; it appears only when "Show hidden too" is on.

efatura.tumAciklama: Invoices received in İzibiz and Protel in one list. Sync and hiding are done on the provider screens.

protel.aciklama: The hotel's e-invoice mailbox (Protel). Read only; nothing is changed in Protel.
protel.modulKapali: The Protel connection is disabled on the server (PROTEL_AKTIF): sync does not run and PDFs do not open.

turler.aciklamaMetni: Types of deductions applied to subcontractors. Excel summaries are linked to these types.

dogrulama.kodCokUzun: Code can be at most 20 characters.
dogrulama.adCokUzun: Name can be at most 100 characters.
dogrulama.kdvAralik: VAT rate must be between 0 and 100.

turler.ekranAciklamasi: This type can only be entered and imported on the selected screen. If left empty it cannot be used on any screen.

projeler.aciklamaMetni: Projects used in deduction records. They can be created manually or imported from the live ERP.
projeler.erpProjesiUyarisi: This project was imported from ERP. Changes made here will be listed for update to the ERP value when fetched from ERP again.

dogrulama.kodCokUzun: Project code can be at most 50 characters.
dogrulama.adCokUzun: Project name can be at most 200 characters.

firmalar.aciklamaMetni: Subcontractor companies subject to deductions. They can be created manually or imported from the live ERP; ERP companies are matched by GUID or tax number.
firmalar.erpFirmasiUyarisi: This company was imported from ERP. Changes made here will be listed for update to the ERP value when fetched from ERP again.

dogrulama.kodCokUzun: Company code can be at most 50 characters.
dogrulama.adCokUzun: Company name can be at most 200 characters.
dogrulama.vknCokUzun: Tax number can be at most 20 characters.
dogrulama.vergiDairesiCokUzun: Tax office can be at most 100 characters.
dogrulama.epostaCokUzun: E-mail can be at most 255 characters.
dogrulama.gsmCokUzun: Mobile number can be at most 30 characters.

firmalar.kodTekrarAciklama: This code is used by more than one company. Excel rows match companies by code, so make the codes distinct.
firmalar.firmamizAciklama: Marks our own company (e.g. HAB); created manually as it is not in the ERP subcontractor list. Only one company can be marked.
firmalar.firmamizDegisecek: Our company is currently "{{kod}} — {{ad}}". Marking this company will remove that mark.

paraBirimleri.aciklamaMetni: Currencies of deduction rows. The Excel "PARA BİRİMİ" value matches by code.

dogrulama.kodCokUzun: Code can be at most 10 characters.
dogrulama.adCokUzun: Name can be at most 50 characters.

icmal.silOnayMesaj: The "{{ad}}" row dated {{tarih}} will be deleted.
icmal.hesapAciklamasi: Charged = Total − Cancelled, Remaining = Charged − Deducted.

iceAktarim.aciklama: Select the Excel file or copy rows from Excel and paste them (copying the header row is recommended). Columns are recognised by header names. Then press Check: if every row passes, Save is enabled; otherwise each invalid row is listed with its reason.

dosyaHatasi.dosya_okunamadi: The file could not be read. Select a valid Excel (.xlsx) file.
dosyaHatasi.baslik_bulunamadi: Header row not found. Column headers (Kesinti Türü, Taşeron Adı, Proje…) must be within the first 20 rows.
dosyaHatasi.satir_yok: There are no rows below the header row.

iceAktarim.hataliDosya: {{sayi}} rows failed the check; nothing is saved until they are fixed. A summary by reason is below, and each row’s error is in the Error column of the table.
iceAktarim.hatasiz: {{sayi}} rows passed the check and are ready to save.

hataKodu.birden_fazla: This code belongs to more than one company; make the codes distinct on the Companies screen
hataKodu.baska_ekranin_turu: Not linked to this screen (Deduction Types → Screen)

yuklemeler.aciklama: Excel imports. A wrong upload can be undone together with its rows; manually entered rows are not affected.
yuklemeler.geriAlOnayMesaj: The upload from {{zaman}} and its {{sayi}} rows will be deleted.

tumu.aciklamaMetni: Records from every deduction screen in a single list with their common columns. No data is entered here; records are entered and corrected on their own deduction screen.

ozet.aciklamaMetni: Deductions from All Deductions up to the selected date, in a single currency: general summary, breakdown by zone (project) and deduction type, and the subcontractors with the highest deductions. HAB Assumed covers deductions with re-invoicing type HAB; the subcontractor share and its Cancelled / Deducted / Remaining come from those with type SUBCONTRACTOR.
ozet.kesintiYok: There are no deduction records yet.
ozet.secimdeKesintiYok: No deductions for the selected date, projects and currency.

pivot.aciklamaMetni: Remaining amount of each deduction type side by side; from All Deductions up to the selected date, in a single currency. Summary shows it per subcontractor and project, Company Summary per subcontractor (projects added up), Project Summary per project (subcontractors added up). Only deductions re-invoiced to the subcontractor count (the remainder of those assumed by HAB is not deducted from the subcontractor; same as Remaining in Deduction Summary). "-" means no deductions of that type; 0.00 means there are deductions but all were deducted. On the Summary tab, click an amount to download that cell’s deduction statement as a PDF (A3 landscape); Total Remaining covers all types of the subcontractor and project. Export to Excel downloads the three tabs as separate sheets.
pivot.kalanYok: No deductions re-invoiced to subcontractors for the selected date, projects, companies and currency.
pivot.ekstreIpucu: Download the deduction statement as PDF

isgucu.aciklamaMetni: Labour deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

kamp.aciklamaMetni: Camp (room) deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

kampMalzeme.aciklamaMetni: Camp material deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

makinaEkipman.aciklamaMetni: Machinery and equipment deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

tutanak.aciklamaMetni: Report (tutanak) deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

yemek.aciklamaMetni: Meal deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

osgb.aciklamaMetni: OSGB Deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

tetkik.aciklamaMetni: Health Check Deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

isgCeza.aciklamaMetni: OHS Penalty Deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

malzeme.aciklamaMetni: Material Deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

kartBasim.aciklamaMetni: Personnel card printing deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

erpAktarim.ozet: {{yeni}} new, {{guncellenecek}} to update, {{eslesecek}} to link with a manual record, {{aktarilamaz}} cannot be imported. {{ayni}} records are already up to date.
erpAktarim.hepsiGuncel: All ERP records are already up to date; nothing to import.

neden.guid_gecersiz: The GUID in ERP is invalid.
neden.guid_tekrar: The same GUID appears in more than one ERP row.
neden.kod_tekrar: The same code is used by more than one ERP record.
neden.kod_baska_kayitta: This code is used by another record in the application.

yapistirma.ipucu: Select and copy rows in Excel, click the table and paste with Ctrl+V. If you copy the header row, columns are matched by name (Excel order does not matter); without it, rows are placed starting at the selected cell. Click a cell to correct it: Enter moves down, Tab moves right.

raporlar.onceCalistirin: Choose the parameters and press Run Report.
raporlar.hazirlaniyor: Reading the report from the ERP…

dogrulama.sonTarihOnce: End date cannot be before the start date.

erpKesintiKontrolu.aciklamaMetni: Amounts entered on the deduction screens by subcontractor, project and currency; on the right, the same group's re-invoiced expense from ERP progress payments and its expense re-invoicing invoice total (VAT included, in the invoice currency). Rows are matched by subcontractor name, project and currency; in projects with deductions, ERP groups without deductions are listed too. The date filter applies to each deduction's, payment's and invoice's own date.

taseronHakedisleri.aciklamaMetni: Subcontract progress payments from the ERP, one row per payment, with currency totals above and below the table. The report is read from the ERP when you press Run Report.
taseronHakedisleri.aramaIpucu: Company, project, contract, invoice no, status, approver…

giderYansitmaFaturalari.aciklamaMetni: Expense re-invoicing invoices from the ERP, one row per invoice; amounts in TRY and in the invoice currency. TRY grand total and currency totals above and below the table. The report is read from the ERP when you press Run Report.
giderYansitmaFaturalari.aramaIpucu: Invoice no, title, project, description, payment, contract, user…

tamam.tara: Backup folder scanned; the list was updated.

istek.ayrilabilirsiniz: The job runs on the server; you may leave this page. The status is shown again when you come back.

ayrinti.tara: Backup folder scanned: {{eklenen}} new, {{guvenilmeyen}} untrusted; the list was updated.
ayrinti.kopya_geri_yukle: Backup restored as {{veritabani}}; see the Restores screen.

yedekler.aciklamaMetni: Database backups, their verification status and off-server copies. Times are Istanbul time.
yedekler.yeniYedekAciklama: The backup runs in the background; the list refreshes when it finishes. Optionally add a note (e.g. "before year-end closing").
yedekler.guvenilmeyenAciklama: The manifest signature is missing or could not be verified. This backup cannot be restored.
yedekler.yalnizSifreliKopya: Only an encrypted copy exists: it cannot be restored from the screen. Follow the recovery guide on the server with the private key and `yedek:sifre-coz` (docs/yedekleme/kurtarma.md).
yedekler.sabitSilinmez: A pinned backup cannot be deleted; unpin it first.
yedekler.silOnayMesaj: Backup {{dosya}} will be deleted from the local disk and from all off-server copies. This cannot be undone.
yedekler.sabitCozOnayMesaj: {{dosya}} will be unpinned. Retention rules may then delete it as well.

hedef.aciklamaMetni: Where backup copies are sent. Copies sent off-server are encrypted with the public key.
hedef.turDesteklenmiyor: This target's type is no longer available on the server; it cannot be edited.
hedef.sirNotu: Password and key fields are never shown; leave blank to keep the saved value. They must be re-entered if the server, port or user changes.
hedef.konumKilitli: This target holds copies: the fields that define where they are stored are locked. Add a new target for another location; passwords / keys can be renewed.
hedef.sunucuDisiNotu: Off-server target: copies are encrypted with the public key from Backup Settings. Without a public key, no copies are sent to this target.

uyari.duz_ftp: Plain FTP is unencrypted: the password and the file travel over the network in clear text. Use FTPS or SFTP if possible.

dogrulama.adUzun: Name can be at most 100 characters.

koruma.etkin: Deletion protection (object lock): enabled — the bucket's own retention rule removes old copies.
koruma.sorgulanamadi: Deletion protection could not be queried (the application lacks permission to read it).

sinama.kaydedilmemisSinandi: Tested with the (unsaved) form values; save to use them.

sftp.ilkSina: The first "Test Connection" stores the server key; later connections are verified against it and refused if it changes.

google.formNotu: After saving the target, connect the account with the "Connect with Google" button in the list. The app can only access files it created.
google.yenidenBaglanin: The Google connection was lost (access revoked or expired). Reconnect; until then no copies are sent to this target.
google.reddedildi: The Google connection was not completed (access denied or the flow was interrupted).

basarili.anahtar_sifirla: Server key reset; the next "Test Connection" stores the new one.

sil.mesaj: Target "{{ad}}" will be deleted. A target used by plans or holding copies cannot be deleted.

google_kes.mesaj: The Google connection of "{{ad}}" will be removed; no copies are sent to this target until it is reconnected.

anahtar_sifirla.mesaj: The stored server key for "{{ad}}" will be forgotten; the next "Test Connection" stores the server's current key. Only do this if you are sure the server key really changed.

plan.aciklamaMetni: When, where and for how long: each plan defines its schedule, its targets and the retention rule per target. Times are Istanbul time.
plan.saatlikNotu: The time window and days are optional (e.g. weekdays 08:00–19:00).
plan.aySonuUyarisi: The selected day does not exist in some months (29–31): in those months the plan runs on the last day of the month.
plan.saklamaNotu: For each target enter "keep last N" and / or "N days"; a copy is kept if it meets either.
plan.hedefKopyaNotu: This plan has {{adet}} copies on this target; the target cannot be removed until retention has cleaned them up.
plan.hedefKopyaliBaslik: Some targets cannot be removed from the plan
plan.hedefKopyaliAciklama: Removing the target would leave these copies without a retention rule. Keep the target in the plan; you can remove it after retention has cleaned up the copies (or deactivate the plan).

onizleme.yok: No runs in the near future.
onizleme.cakisanlar: Other plans at the same time
onizleme.cakismaAciklama: A single backup is taken and copied to the targets of all these plans.
onizleme.silinecekYok: Nothing would be deleted by these rules right now.

neden.uzak_kopya_var: has a remote copy; local file not needed

plan.silOnayMesaj: Plan "{{ad}}" will be deleted. A plan with copies cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.

dogrulama.adUzun: Name can be at most 100 characters.
dogrulama.saatlikAralik: Enter a number of hours between 1 and 24.
dogrulama.gunlukAralik: Enter a number of days between 1 and 366.
dogrulama.hedefTekrar: The same target cannot be added twice.
dogrulama.saklamaZorunlu: The retention rule cannot be empty: enter keep-last or days.

gunluk.aciklamaMetni: Audit trail of backup operations: who, when, which backup, result, duration. Entries are read-only; they cannot be deleted or changed from this screen.
gunluk.aralikHatali: The start cannot be after the end.

ayarlar.aciklamaMetni: Retention of unscheduled backups, cleanup thresholds, notifications, heartbeat signals and the encryption key for off-server copies.
ayarlar.saklamaAciklama: How long backups not tied to a plan (pre-deploy, manual, pre-restore) are kept. Plan backups follow the plan's own rule.
ayarlar.sifirNotu: 0: that criterion is not used. Even after expiry, at least the minimum number of successful backups is kept on each target.
ayarlar.sinyalNotu: After each successful operation an "I'm alive" signal is sent to these addresses; if it is late, the external monitor raises the alarm. Empty addresses are not used.

dogrulama.aralik: Enter a whole number between {{en}} and {{cok}}.
dogrulama.aliciGecersiz: There is an invalid e-mail address.
dogrulama.aliciTekrar: The same address is listed more than once.
dogrulama.sinyal: Enter an address starting with https:// only.

anahtar.aciklama: Copies sent to off-server targets are encrypted with this public key (OpenPGP). The private key is never stored on the server; it is provided at restore time.
anahtar.yok: No public key: copies are NOT sent to off-server targets (they are never sent unencrypted).
anahtar.yalnizAcik: Paste only the public key starting with "-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----"; private keys are rejected.
anahtar.kaldirOnayMesaj: Once the key is removed, copies to off-server targets stop (they are never sent unencrypted). Only local backups are taken until a new key is uploaded.

geriYukleme.aciklamaMetni: Restore history and copies restored under a new name that are waiting to be deleted. The live database (erp) is never touched from this screen. Times are Istanbul time.
geriYukleme.bekleyenlerAciklama: Databases restored under a new name are deleted automatically when the waiting period ends. You can delete them earlier when you are done.
geriYukleme.suresiDoldu: Expired; removed at the next cleanup
geriYukleme.silOnayMesaj: Database {{veritabani}} will be dropped permanently. The live database (erp) is not affected. This cannot be undone.

kopya.canliyaDokunmaz: The backup is restored into a new database; the live database (erp) is never touched. You can inspect the copy and take the data you need.
kopya.otomatikSilinir: The copy is deleted automatically when the server's waiting period ends (default 7 days). The deletion date and manual deletion are on the Restores screen.
kopya.yerelDosyaYok: This backup has no local file; it is restored from an unencrypted copy (e.g. a second disk).
kopya.ekGecersiz: The suffix may contain only lowercase letters (a–z) and digits, at most 16 characters.

ustune.kayipUyarisi: This backup was taken at {{zaman}} ({{dosya}}). Everything entered after that moment will be deleted.
ustune.kayipDonemi: Lost period: all records entered between {{baslangic}} and {{bitis}} (now).

ozet.bakim: The application enters maintenance mode; queue and scheduled jobs stop. Nobody can work until it finishes.
ozet.oncesiYedek: First a "pre-restore" backup of the live database is taken and verified.
ozet.yeniVeritabani: The backup is restored into a new database where migrations and checks run; the live database is untouched up to here.
ozet.oncekiSaklanir: The databases are swapped: today's database is not deleted but kept as erp_onceki_* so you can go back.
ozet.onay: Finally the differences are shown; the application stays in maintenance mode until you click "Approve".
ozet.oturum: The swap ends all sessions; the operation is tracked with an access key (stored in this browser, valid for 8 hours).

ustune.adBilinmiyor: The live database name could not be read; the operation cannot start.
ustune.adiYazin: To confirm, type the live database name exactly: {{ad}}
ustune.anahtarYok: This browser does not have the access key for this operation (started from another browser, already finished, or the record was removed). You can follow it on the server with the emergency command below.

durumAciklama.kuyrukta: The request was handed to the runner; it will start shortly.
durumAciklama.calisiyor: The application is in maintenance mode. You may close this page; reopening it resumes tracking.
durumAciklama.onay_bekliyor: The backup is now live but the application is still in maintenance mode. Review the differences below, then approve or go back.
durumAciklama.hata: An error occurred after the swap. The application is in maintenance mode; the decision to open or go back is yours.
durumAciklama.onaylandi: The backup is live and the application is open again. Sessions were ended; please sign in again.
durumAciklama.geri_donuldu: Rolled back to the old database; the application opened with it.
durumAciklama.basarisiz: The operation was rolled back; the live database is unchanged.
durumAciklama.bilinmiyor: The operation state does not show this operation; inspect with the emergency command.

adim.yazici_bariyeri: Stopping sessions that write to the live database

ustune.kararBasarisiz: Your decision could not be processed: {{neden}}
ustune.bittiNotu: The operation finished; the access key was removed from this browser.
ustune.onaylaOnayMesaj: The backup will stay live and the application will reopen. Going back to the old database afterwards loses records entered in between.
ustune.geriDonOnayMesaj: The database names will be swapped back and the application will open with today's (old) database. The restored copy is not deleted and stays closed to connections.

ayarSecimi.aciklama: The settings groups below differ between today and the restored backup. Choose for each one; approval is not possible without a choice.
ayarSecimi.kopyaYok: The settings file copy could not be read; only "restored" can be chosen.
ayarSecimi.eksik: First choose for every settings group that differs.

acil.aciklama: If the screen cannot be opened or the access key is lost / expired, status, approval and rollback are done on the server with these commands:
acil.belge: Run the commands as the service account with the service environment (docs/yedekleme/sunucu-kurulumu.md, kurtarma.md).

bilgi.oncekiBilinmiyor: Today's state could not be read; differences cannot be shown. Check users and settings separately before approving.
bilgi.kaybolacakYukleme: {{sayi}} imports (uploads) made after the backup are not in the restored data; they are lost if you approve.
